name: Conduent
desc:
Healthcare Contact Center Associate - Work from Home | $16.50/hr | Inbound Calls and Email, No Sales Expectations
Company: Conduent
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Conduent runs customer support for large companies, and this team supports a telehealth service where patients see doctors by phone or video. You'll answer about 20 calls a day plus emails from patients. They might ask about visit costs, insurance coverage, or a charge on their card, need help signing into the app or joining a video visit, or want to know if their prescription was sent to the pharmacy. You'll help patients schedule virtual visits, walk them through self-service options for visit history, sick slips, and records, and send billing issues like refunds to the billing team. You'll work in three computer systems at once and gather patient feedback along the way.

Soft Skills
- Empathy and patience
- Problem solving
- Multitasking across systems
- Clear communication
- Dependability and punctuality
assessment: Yes. The application includes prescreen questions, a 2-minute typing test, and a 10-minute customer service assessment, about 20 minutes total. It must be done on a computer with a keyboard, not a phone.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma, GED, or college degree
Required Experience: None. Customer service experience is a plus but not required.
Preferred Experience: Customer service

Required Skills:
- Problem solving and multitasking
- Strong communication
- Navigating 3 computer systems while on calls
- Open availability, including weekends
- Pass a background check
- Home internet at 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload, hardwired by ethernet (no satellite or wireless internet)
- A quiet, clutter-free workspace with no one else in the room during work hours

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Is new to customer service and wants paid training
- Wants health benefits starting on day one
- Has open availability, including nights and weekends
- Is comfortable with apps and helping people with tech problems

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Needs a set daytime schedule
- Can't attend every day of the 4-week training
- Can't hardwire their internet
- Can't keep their workspace private during shifts
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Apply and enter your basic profile information (about 2 minutes)
2. Answer prescreen questions (about 3 minutes)
3. Complete a typing test (about 2 minutes, keyboard required)
4. Take a short customer service assessment (about 10 minutes)
5. Watch for an email about next steps
Steps 1 to 4 come from the posting and take under 20 minutes total. Step 5 is estimated.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Inbound call center
- Healthcare customer service
- Telehealth support
- Insurance verification
- Billing questions
- Technical troubleshooting
- Appointment scheduling
- Email support
- Multitasking across systems
- HIPAA and confidentiality

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about any customer service experience you have.
- A patient can't sign into the app and didn't get a password reset email. How do you help?
- What does dependability and punctuality mean to you?
- Tell us about a time you helped someone who was stressed or upset. What happened, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you learned a new computer system quickly. What was it, how did you learn it, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $16.50/hr. May be eligible for a bonus or incentive based on business need.
-Shift: Open availability required. Hours of operation are 24/7/365, and schedules are assigned during training based on business need. Weekend availability is required.
-Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision start on your first day. PTO starts after 180 days (about 6 months). Also life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, and paid holidays.
-Equipment Provided: Yes. Conduent provides the computer, monitor, mouse, keyboard, headset, ethernet cord, and power cables.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case. A background check is required, but not every conviction rules someone out.
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: A true no-experience healthcare job with health benefits on day one and all equipment provided. Training is 3 weeks of paid virtual training plus 1 week of nesting, and you can't miss a day. The assessment must be taken on a computer, not a phone. Not hiring in AK, CA, CT, HI, IL, MA, MD, MT, NJ, NY, OR, or WA, or in some metro areas. Camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Healthcare Contact Center Associate → Senior Associate or Subject Matter Expert → Team Lead → Operations Supervisor. Conduent says there are plenty of growth opportunities on the healthcare team. This role builds healthcare customer service, telehealth, and technical support skills.
training: 3 wks paid virtual training + 1 wk nesting, 100% attendance required
